name: Logistics / Transportation
description: Transport, courier, freight, warehousing and delivery vendors. Custody of goods in transit is the defining risk, so cover and carrier licensing lead.

fields.label: Vehicles operated
fields.why: Owned or contracted vehicles available for our lanes.

fields.label: Primary service region
fields.why: Determines which lanes we can allocate and whether customs capability is needed.

fields.label: Do you provide warehousing?
fields.why: Storing our goods requires warehouse liability cover in addition to transit cover.

documents.label: Goods-in-transit insurance
documents.why: Covers our goods while they are in your custody. Non-negotiable before first dispatch.
documents.expects: A current goods-in-transit insurance certificate naming the business

documents.label: Carrier / transport licence
documents.why: Operating vehicles commercially requires a valid transport licence.
documents.expects: A commercial carrier or transport operator licence naming the business

documents.label: Warehouse licence / liability cover
documents.why: Storage carries a separate liability exposure from transit.
documents.expects: A warehouse licence or warehouse liability insurance certificate

documents.label: Customs / IEC registration
documents.why: Cross-border movement requires an import-export registration.
documents.expects: An import-export code or customs broker registration certificate
